propositions: Replace the module-size allowlist exemption mechanism with an absolute 800 LOC cap enforced from a single source file (.github/module-size-limit.txt).
Implement a limit-lock that reads main's limit file via explicit GitHub URL fetch and blocks any limit increase unless the change is admin-forced override.

Rewrite the module-size gate step identically in both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml workflows to read the limit file, reject absolute cap violations, and validate the lock; fail if the limit file is missing or unparseable.
The lock must emit a warning (not silently fail) if main's tip cannot be fetched, falling back to the always-on absolute cap floor.
Update test_module_size_contract.py to verify no src/rebar file exceeds the cap read from the limit file, and update test_ci_workflow_parity.py to expect the new limit file in both workflows.
Retain the now-empty allowlist and ceilings files to prevent breakage of main's current CI gate during this change's own validation; deletion is deferred to Phase 2b.
